clean_tool_results.description: Allows the model to clean redundant tool results.
rules: Use <CLEAN_TOOL_RESULTS> to delete ALL tool results and clean all block OR use <CLEAN_TOOL_RESULTS: T1 > to remove ONLY one existing TOOL_RESULT whose tool_id is exactly T1; every other result stays. Supply one exact T<number> ID from the current TOOLS_RESULTS block.
